protocol.sample_limits: Three measured trials per model. Sequential order and changing heat/clocks can affect results; no randomized repetitions or confidence intervals.
protocol.prompt_cache: Not disabled; trials share substantial prompt prefix. Reported prefill can include cache effects.
protocol.generated_tokens: Decode counts include all engine-generated tokens, including reasoning. GPT-OSS returned thinking despite think:false; answer-only throughput was not measured.
protocol.warmup_basis: First request after load. Ollama load_duration retained in raw warmup; vLLM startup_to_ready_s retained in model metadata. Warmup is excluded from ranked medians.

decode_basis.vLLM: stream estimate (completion_tokens - 1) / (last-content time - first-content time); not engine-native decode
decode_basis.TensorFold: engine usage.completion_tokens / tensorfold.decode_s. MTP drafting was enabled: up to 6 drafts a round, stop before a draft under confidence 0.60. Accepted drafts count as output tokens. This is not a vLLM stream estimate.

protocol.configuration_caveat: Ollama context8192; existing FP8 vLLM service context262144 and GPU memory utilization0.90; extra vLLM context8192 eager single sequence utilization0.80. Different model tokenizers and kernel settings prevent strict apples-to-apples hardware comparisons. TensorFold Qwen3.8-Flash-Next uses context 262144, 5 server slots, int8 KV, MLX 4-bit weights, MTP drafting on; the published trials are still one request at a time.

TensorFold.request: text only, temperature 0, thinking off, seed 20260928

protocol.scope: Single-request text throughput; excludes answer quality, vision, tools, long context and concurrent serving. Three short measured trials do not establish long-duration thermal stability. CPU background services remained running; some trials overlapped authorized dashboard work and BF16 download.
protocol.load_caveat: Warmup follows model unloading; filesystem caches were not cleared. Startup is not guaranteed cold-disk startup.
